text: Then, appeased, he subsided on the deck in a sitting posture, hugging with his arms and legs the stand of the engine-room telegraph--an iron casting as thick as a post. When that went, why, he expected he would go, too. He gave no more thought to the coolies. Captain MacWhirr had made Jukes understand that he wanted him to go down below--to see. “What am I to do then, sir?” And the trembling of his whole wet body caused Jukes' voice to sound like bleating.
